# PickAI - The Authority on Artificial Intelligence

> PickAI is a premium editorial source for AI news, research analysis, tool reviews, and expert opinion.

## Site Overview

- **Domain**: https://pickai.netlify.app/
- **Type**: News & Editorial Website
- **Focus**: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning
- **Language**: English (en-US)

## Main Sections

### 1. AI News (Homepage)
- **URL**: /index.html
- **Content**: Daily updates on models, policy, industry moves, and breaking AI developments
- **Topics**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Model Releases, AI Policy

### 2. Research Journal
- **URL**: /research.html
- **Content**: Deep-dive analysis of arXiv papers and academic research
- **Topics**: Transformers, State Space Models (SSMs), Diffusion Models, RLHF, Multimodal AI

### 3. AI Tools Directory
- **URL**: /tools/index.html
- **Content**: Curated directory of verified AI software and platforms
- **Categories**: LLMs, Image Generation, Video Generation, Coding, Writing, Automation

### 4. Opinion & Perspectives
- **URL**: /opinion.html
- **Content**: Expert commentary on AI alignment, ethics, economics, and societal impact
- **Contributors**: Industry leaders, researchers, and policy experts

### 5. Explainers & Guides
- **URL**: /explainers.html
- **Content**: Beginner-friendly explanations of complex AI concepts
- **Topics**: What is a Transformer, How LLMs Work, Neural Network Basics

## Content Philosophy

We prioritize:
- Technical accuracy over speed
- Human-verified reporting
- Independent editorial standards
- Transparency about AI use in our own workflows

## Contact

- **Press**: info.mraaglave@gmail.com

## Technical Details

- **Framework**: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- **Hosting**: Netlify
- **Structured Data**: JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, Article, BreadcrumbList)
- **Feeds**: RSS (/rss.xml), Sitemap (/sitemap.xml)
